clue.text: Powder used by Faust (alchemist)

indicators.note: used by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The legendary Faust, dabbling in alchemy, reaches for a jar of powder.
explanation.definitionFit: Talc is a soft mineral ground into a fine powder, as in talcum powder.

clue.text: Strain shown by rest at sea on steamship

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters of rest are jumbled

explanation.surface: A passenger on a steamship finds that resting while afloat shows the strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress and strain are synonyms for pressure or tension, mental or physical.

clue.text: Houseman, English, twice confined suspected terrorist

parts.note: a houseman is a junior hospital doctor, an intern

indicators.note: twice says the letter for English is written two times in a row

explanation.surface: An English hospital doctor is held, suspected of terrorism.
explanation.walkthrough: A houseman is the British term for a junior resident doctor in a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: An internee is a person held in custody without trial, as suspected terrorists have been.

clue.text: Heavy metal guitar accessory?

definitions.meaning: a dense, heavy metallic element, symbol Pb
the cable plugging an electric guitar into its amplifier

explanation.surface: A heavy-metal musician reaches for a piece of guitar kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Lead is the soft heavy metal Pb, and also the cord connecting a guitar to an amp.

clue.text: Husband in Christmas show, Marley at first, then ghost

indicators.note: in says the husband letter goes inside the Christmas show word

parts.note: a panto, short for pantomime, is the British family stage show staged around Christmas

indicators.note: at first takes just the opening letter of Marley

explanation.surface: A Christmas stage show where Marley appears first, then a ghost, as in A Christmas Carol.
explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime is a comic family theatre show staged in Britain at Christmas. Marley evokes Marley's ghost in A Christmas Carol, which sits neatly with the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A phantom is a spectre or apparition, a ghost.

clue.text: Writer in favour of American technique, initially

parts.note: pro means in favour of, as in pros and cons
US is short for American, as in the US

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of technique

explanation.surface: A writer who backs an American method of working.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcel Proust was the French novelist who wrote In Search of Lost Time.

clue.text: One employed by F1 team, male, by newly-built chicane

indicators.note: newly-built suggests the letters of chicane are put together afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A man from a Formula One team stands by a freshly constructed chicane on the circuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing teams employ mechanics to service and repair their cars.

clue.text: Birds chatter about new bag

indicators.note: about means around, so the chatter word wraps the other pieces

parts.note: to gas is to chatter idly
to net is to bag or catch

explanation.surface: Birds chatter around a newly acquired bag.
explanation.definitionFit: Gannets are large white seabirds that dive for fish.

clue.text: Bell sounding? I must leave

indicators.note: must leave says the letter I is taken out

parts.note: a bell that is going is sounding, ringing out

explanation.surface: Someone hears a bell ringing and announces that they must leave.
explanation.definitionFit: A gong is a metal disc struck to ring out like a bell.

clue.text: Waste energy making jam

parts.note: scrap is waste material
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Wasting energy in a traffic jam.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrape is a tight spot or predicament, as is a jam.

clue.text: Only admitting copper at the right moment

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the copper symbol goes inside

parts.note: one can mean only, as in the one and only
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Only one police officer was admitted at exactly the right time.
explanation.definitionFit: On cue means at precisely the right or expected moment, like an actor's prompt.

clue.text: Candidate's cold sore, one almost being concealed

indicators.note: being concealed says the trimmed word for one is tucked inside the other pieces

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
tender means sore or painful to the touch

indicators.note: almost says the word drops its last letter

parts.note: one written as a word

explanation.surface: A candidate tries to hide a cold sore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Candidate's' reads as possessive, but the 's is just a link. 'cold sore' looks like one thing; split it into cold and sore.
explanation.definitionFit: A contender is someone competing for a post or title, a candidate.

clue.text: First to spot a spot of misguided flattery

indicators.note: First to takes the opening letter of spot
misguided suggests the letters of a spot of are sent astray into a new order

explanation.surface: Spotting a little misguided flattery comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misguided' rearranges A SPOT OF into OFTSOAP, after the S from 'First to spot'.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft soap is persuasive flattery, sweet talk used to win someone over.

clue.text: Weak female needs to get on track

parts.note: a rail is a railway track

explanation.surface: A weak woman needs to board a train.
explanation.definitionFit: Frail means physically weak or delicate.

clue.text: Fungus among bundle brought back

parts.note: in means among, as in one in a crowd

indicators.note: brought back says the word for bundle is read in reverse

parts.note: a pack is a bundle

explanation.surface: A fungus found among a bundle that someone brought home.
explanation.definitionFit: The ink cap is a mushroom whose gills dissolve into black liquid.

clue.text: Dance clubs round northern Georgia

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
O is round in shape
GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: Dancing in nightclubs around northern Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: The conga is a Latin American dance done in a long snaking line.

clue.text: Tea, say, and beer gave out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are disordered, put out of place

explanation.surface: Someone serving tea gave out beer instead.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is one example of a drink, and beverage is the general word for a drink.

clue.text: Right to ring head of faculty after answer relating to a Greek mathematician

indicators.note: after says the following pieces come behind the abbreviation for answer

parts.note: to chime is to ring like a bell
a dean heads a university faculty

explanation.surface: A ringing summons for the head of a university faculty after an answer about Greek mathematics.
explanation.definitionFit: Archimedes was the Greek mathematician of Syracuse, and the adjective describes things connected with him, like the Archimedean screw.

clue.text: Paved footpath in grounds, wide, leading to a yard

parts.note: grounds for complaint are a cause
W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide

explanation.surface: A paved path across the grounds, wide, leads to a yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A causeway is a raised road or path, often paved, across wet ground.

clue.text: Temple of a deity in Pennsylvania

indicators.note: in says the other pieces sit inside the Pennsylvania abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania
a deity is a god

explanation.surface: A temple to a god located in Pennsylvania.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower serving as a Buddhist or Hindu temple.

clue.text: A professional companion his age, surprisingly

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters of his age turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A hired companion's age turns out to be surprising.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese woman trained to entertain and keep company with guests.

clue.text: Practically everyone, contrary to expectation

parts.note: all means everyone
but introduces something contrary to what is expected

explanation.surface: Practically everyone behaved against expectations.
explanation.definitionFit: All but means very nearly or almost, as in all but finished.

clue.text: Something from the watercolourist?

parts.note: read as one who paints the water, the artist produces a picture of the ocean

explanation.definitionFit: A seascape is a painting of the sea, natural work for an artist who paints water.

clue.text: Church officer attacked carrying cross

indicators.note: carrying means holding, so the attack phrase holds the cross letter

parts.note: set on means attacked
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A church officer is attacked while carrying a cross.
explanation.definitionFit: A sexton looks after a church and its graveyard, often ringing bells and digging graves.

clue.text: Speak about short time in lodge

indicators.note: about means around, so the speak word goes round the time letter

parts.note: to say is to speak
T is short for time

explanation.surface: Talking about a brief stay in a lodge.
explanation.definitionFit: To lodge somewhere is to stay there for a time as a guest or tenant.

clue.text: Rector has confused band

indicators.note: confused suggests the letters of Rector has are mixed up

explanation.surface: A rector has a confused band in the parish.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra is a large band of musicians.

clue.text: Study involving the origin of rye and another crop

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the study word holds the letter

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart

indicators.note: the origin of takes the first letter of rye

explanation.surface: Studying the origins of rye and other cereal crops.
explanation.definitionFit: Rye is a cereal crop, and corn is another, a grain crop such as maize or wheat.

clue.text: Photographs ten broad flat fish

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten
rays are broad flat cartilaginous fish

explanation.surface: Photographs of ten broad flat fish.
explanation.definitionFit: X-ray images are photographs taken with penetrating radiation.

clue.text: Song from Callas needing no introduction

indicators.note: needing no introduction says the first letter is dropped

parts.note: Maria Callas was the celebrated opera soprano

explanation.surface: A song from Maria Callas, a singer who needs no introduction.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera.

clue.text: A pound, cash thus far

parts.note: L stands for pound, from the Latin libra
the ready is slang for cash

explanation.surface: A pound is all the cash gathered so far.
explanation.definitionFit: Already means by this time, up to now.

clue.text: Heather coming round to put back risqué books

indicators.note: coming round means surrounding, so the heather word encloses the other piece

parts.note: erica is the botanical genus of heather

indicators.note: put back says the word to is reversed

explanation.surface: Heather drops by to return some saucy books.
explanation.definitionFit: Erotica is literature or art intended to arouse, books with risqué content.
